title: Healthy Core Metabolism: Defining the Physiological Basis for Preventive Health and Drug Development
description: This article synthesizes the concept of a 'Healthy Core Metabolism' (HCM) as a stable, optimal physiological state crucial for long-term health and disease prevention. It explores the fundamental biochemical principles of HCM, details methodologies for its investigation in preclinical and clinical settings (e.g., metabolomics, flux analysis), and examines its application in validating drug targets, advancing preventive nutrition, and developing novel therapeutics.
